_comment: Report sources for the automated daily pull (.github/workflows/daily-pull.yml).
Add an entry with "active": true once the county publishes the cycle's
daily report URL, and the scheduled job will fetch, parse, reconcile and
commit it every morning during early voting. Nothing else needs changing —
scripts/gen-data.mjs picks the CSVs up from data/parsed/ automatically once
the cycle is registered in its CYCLES list.
The parse is self-checking: every column is asserted against the grand
totals the report prints, so a mid-cycle change to the PDF layout fails
the job instead of committing wrong numbers.

sources.note: URL unknown until Fairfax publishes the Nov 2026 report. Historically the pattern has been https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/elections/sites/elections/files/Assets/Documents/PDF/AB-Daily-Report-Nov<YEAR>.pdf — verify before enabling.
